regime_context: Broad US thematic tape is risk-off: the top of the ranks is dominated by eligible, trend-tagged, crowded defensives (Big Pharma, healthcare, staples, defensives) while momentum leader Memory/HBM is ineligible (gate blocked, narrow breadth 0.0) and most tech/AI themes rank negative or ineligible. Absolute-trend gate is validated ('gate_helps': true), so the eligible/trend leg is the only trustworthy tilt; rotation is 'narrowing' and non-directional, so there is no confirmed handoff to flag.
emerging_watch: Watching Retail (eligible, durability 0.71, breadth 0.857, crowded) — if XLY's relative strength vs XLP holds above its 10-day average while eligible breadth rises above 0.9, retire the watch and treat Retail as a confirmed trend-status leadership; fade nothing on crowding alone.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the highest-scoring eligible theme with a strong durability bar (0.84), trend-tag, full breadth (1.0), and validation state 'confirming', while also being the headline theme. The only trustworthy leg is the absolute-trend gate; this theme clears it with breadth and durability cohesion, so a modest directional lean is defensible.
evidence: crowding_z=1.46 (crowded=true) — size-down caution only, not a fade
theses.dissent: High crowding (z=1.46) means the easy money is likely made; PPH as a proxy is concentrated in a handful of mega-caps and can lag XLV on rotation into broader healthcare.

falsifier.text: PPH lags XLV by 3% on a 10-day relative basis before the check-by date

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Health Care (EW) is eligible and trend-tagged with very strong breadth (0.917) and durability (0.78), and is highly crowded (z=1.54, a size-down caution). It shares the same defensive trend-status leg as Big Pharma but is less concentrated, making it a cleaner, more diversified expression of the eligible defensive trend.
theses.dissent: Crowding at z=1.54 is extreme; a crowded defensive can underperform in a mean-reverting tape or if a broad risk-on rally resumes, and XLV overlaps heavily with the Big Pharma theme.

falsifier.text: XLV lags SPY by 4% over 15 trading days before the check-by date

theses.subject: Consumer Staples (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Staples (EW) clears the trend gate with eligible=true, trend tag, durability 0.80, and high breadth 0.879 — but carries the highest crowding z (1.89) among eligible trend themes. This is a defensive trend-status lean at exactly the kind of crowding where the mandate is to down-size, not to chase.
theses.dissent: Extreme crowding (z=1.89) suggests the trade is consensus; staples can lag sharply if bond yields or risk appetite mean-revert, and XLP as a proxy is heavily weighted to a few names.

falsifier.text: XLP lags XLU by 3% over 15 trading days before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
